title: three inconsistent patterns for secretx handling make contribution unclear
description: Secretx is handled three different ways: (A) resolve_secret_uri helper in transit/reader main for UTF-8 string fields; (B) PinningApiKey::resolve() method on the type itself; (C) inline secretx::from_uri + store.get() + as_bytes() for binary/TLS fields. Pattern B is the most maintainable (the type owns its own resolution) but is only used for PinningApiKey. A future contributor adding a new secretx-capable field has no clear canonical pattern to follow. Either document the decision or converge on one pattern with a comment explaining when inline is acceptable.
